reviewer: Supplementary LLM researcher reading; not an independent human reader, and not a product language model.
method: Read all 18 exact English basic bodies and the same fixed physical facts after root froze its pre-prose obligations. A primary question is not compulsory: another useful bounded answer can pass. Required price is judged by the actual selected claim/episode and original identities, not by SAN count, literal SAN presence, all PV captures, word count, or event size.
useful_complete_definition: The basic text must communicate a useful choice difference or coherent working mechanism with enough answer in both relevant arms; the actual reply and price that change that selected answer must survive. A named continuation alone is not the missing arm answer. Long but semantically complete answers can pass this content test and are separately logged as diffuse; isolated true fragments in an otherwise unanswered comparison do not pass.
scope: Original v6 engine run and original frontend outcome are preserved. The separately fixed frontend shows the identical stored C12 body; its rejected follow-up was not rerun. No product tuning, new engine, position replacement, or first-cohort relabeling in this reading.

findings: Role-count prices can convey a lost supporting knight or attacked knight without displaying every capture SAN: C07 and W24-09 are valid examples, because the actual price is expressed and exact proof refs remain.

Own gain/use can be delivered while an economically reversing same-episode event is still absent: Rg1 loses the White queen, Re1 loses c3, Qxa7 is answered by Qxb2, Qxc5 follows Raxb8, and Nxe3/Nxg2 expose the Black queen and recover a White rook.
C12 public delivery failed on a preexisting single-square reconstruction of an actual certified two-square pawn advance. Only decoder delivery was fixed; the original run failure is retained.
Several partial answers are useful as fragments but do not answer the other arm beyond a recorded move name; actual contrast/identity/continuation matters more than a SAN token being present.

Many complete answers remain diffuse because support, history, withdrawals, endpoint presence, and unrelated later targets are all promoted into the same basic unit. This content selection problem is independent of proof/receipt separation.
No forced-win/draw or unsupported attack-removal claim was found in the read core; root assessment needs_refresh/stopped verification remains a separate execution limitation.
limits: These are researcher reading judgments, not independent human-reader results. Readability and utility remain partly subjective.
Scope-sensitive prices are not added to the high-confidence omission count. A strictly bounded initial transaction can legitimately omit a later independent capture.
The complete-but-diffuse category is not a demonstration of short natural default prose, and the content gate remains 14/18 with zero important omissions.

The 18 selected facts were pre-choice balanced by admitted unrestricted D16; partial or bounded whole search outcomes were rejected, and all original follow-up failures remain in execution diagnostics.
